description: This file declares the interface for the updateHandler class which manages update events and callbacks within the host interface component of a TR-069 management system. It includes function declarations for initializing, stopping, resetting, and running the handler thread, as well as a callback notification method. The file also declares a utility function for sending add/remove events.

classes.name: updateHandler
classes.description: A class providing static methods to handle updates, including initialization, thread management, stopping, resetting, and callback notification for host interface update events.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the updateHandler, setting up necessary resources and starting the handler thread.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the updateHandler's operations and thread.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the updateHandler to its initial state.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Function run by the handler thread to process update events.

methods.name: notifyCallback
methods.description: Callback function to notify registered handlers of an update event.
